text.tspan: The left side of the TT030 case contains the following items from left to right. Reset button,
LAN connector, MIDI OUT jack, MIDI IN jack, ROM cartridge port, and keyboard jack.
The rear of the TT030 contains the following items. SCSI interface jack, External floppy jack,
external ACSI interface connector, printer connector, monitor jack, VME slot, modem 1
connector, on/off switch, power plug, modem 2 connector, fan, audio R connector, and audio L
